content.title: SHOCKING Facts About Jesus' Resurrection
content.text: Membership: https://www.brandonrobbinsministry.co... _________________________________________________ The resurrection is even more amazing than we think. As you dig deeper into the accounts of the resurrection, you find that they’re filled with strange and confusing details like how Jesus’ body is given to his enemies, or how the key witnesses to the event, don’t even tell anyone. These are things that you would never include in an account like this…unless they were true. And, ultimately, that’s the whole point. In the eyes of the gospel writers, the account of the resurrection is the most important moment in all of scripture. Every detail matters. And here’s why this is so important for us: because without it Christianity MAKES NO SENSE. _________________________________________________ I will receive partial compensation through affiliate links.
